# Before you start

This document is living and is being created currently for the benefit of all users. There already exists a ForestPlots user manual, but we hope that this document can accompany that to guide users through case examples to work with their data. It is extremely important that a member of the ForestPlots team first shows you how to work with the data before you attempt to do this on your own.

In the meantime, your feedback is especially important so if you find that it is not meeting your needs, please inform a member of the ForestPlots team so that we can improve this document.
